core_meaning.short_meaning: Small protective garment; beloved companion Julaybib al-Ansari.
core_meaning.primary_meaning: Julaybib (جُلَيْبِيب) is an Arabic masculine given name meaning 'a small shielding garment' or 'modest cloak of protection'. In Islamic history, it belongs to the deeply beloved companion Julaybib al-Ansari, about whom the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ famously declared three times: 'He is from me, and I am from him' (هَذَا مِنِّي وَأَنَا مِنْهُ).
core_meaning.literal_meaning: Diminutive form of jilbāb, conveying affectionate modesty, shielding dignity, and humility.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: The root j-l-b denotes bringing, drawing close, or wrapping in an outer garment (jilbāb). Julaybib was a modest, unassuming member of the early Medinan community who possessed neither noble lineage nor worldly wealth. The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ personally arranged his marriage to a pious Ansari noblewoman and profoundly honored his supreme sacrifice when he was martyred in battle defending the Muslims.
